value.rationale: The rank of average quantum mixing matrices on primitive distance-regular graphs is an explicitly published mathematical gap (Coutinho-Guo 2024, Open Problem 4.1). The theorem covers all triple-subset Johnson graphs of diameter three, identifies the sharp antipodal cutoff n=6 versus every n>=7, and proves quantitative positivity of a single spectral Schur square. This is a natural complete infinite-family rank classification rather than a manufactured numerical slice. It does not settle the general problem or higher Johnson diameters.
